newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangshen Railway down on fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: Guangshen Railway down on fare cuts.

text.p: Shares of Guangshen Railway Co Ltd fell on Tuesday after the company announced it would cut fares on its high-speed trains running between Guangzhou and Shenzhen, brokers said.
"Its earnings are likely to be hit after it lowers its fares," said Patrick Chia, research manager at China Everbright Research.
Guangshen Railway shares fell HK$0.10, or 3.28 percent, to HK$2.95 in mid-morning trade after shedding HK$0.15, or 4.69 percent, on Monday.
Brokers said there was concern that the market would revise down earnings forecasts for Guangshen Railway following the fare cuts which would be effective from November 1.
Guangshen Railway said on Monday it would cut its fares on the Guangzhou-Shenzhen route by 22.22 percent to 70 yuan for first-class fares and by 18.75 percent to 65 yuan for second-class fares.
